faqs.question: What is Candorify?
faqs.answer: Candorify checks your itemized medical bill for possible mistakes before you pay. We read every charge, explain each billing code in plain words, point out charges worth asking about, and write the letter for you.

faqs.question: How do I check my bill?
faqs.answer: Sign up for free, open Check a bill and upload your bill as a PDF. Then check the charges we read, answer a few quick questions, review what looks off, and send the letter from your own email. It takes about five minutes.

faqs.question: What is an itemized bill and how do I get one?
ask: how do i get an itemized bill
where do i get my itemized bill
faqs.answer: An itemized bill lists every charge with its code and price. Ask your hospital or doctor's billing office for one, or use our request letter (Letters page). You have the right to a copy of your billing records.

faqs.question: I only have a summary bill. Can I still use it?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upload it and we'll check the total and look for repeated charges. To check every charge in detail, ask your provider for a fully itemized bill. Our request letter can do that for you.

faqs.question: What mistakes do you look for?
faqs.answer: We look for double charges, bad math (price times quantity), wrong totals, odd quantities, extra room days compared with your answers, and codes that are hard to understand.

faqs.question: Does a flag mean my bill is wrong?
ask: are you sure it's a mistake
faqs.answer: Not always. A flag is a possible issue worth asking about, not a confirmed error. You decide which ones to include, and your provider gives the final answer.

faqs.question: Do you keep my bill? Is my data safe?
faqs.answer: We never store your PDF. We read the charges, leave out your name and account numbers, and delete your bill data when you finish. Survey answers are kept without your bill.

faqs.question: Can I upload a photo of my bill?
faqs.answer: Not yet. For now please upload a PDF. Photo upload is coming soon. Most hospitals can email your bill or post it to your patient portal as a PDF.

faqs.question: How big can my PDF be?
faqs.answer: Up to 5 MB, one bill at a time. If the upload fails, make sure it's a text PDF of the bill, not a scanned photo.

faqs.question: What do the codes on my bill mean?
faqs.answer: Each charge has a billing code (like CPT, HCPCS or a hospital revenue code). Tap a code on your charges, or use Code lookup, to see what it means in plain words.

faqs.question: Can I see my bill in another language?
faqs.answer: Yes. Code explanations can be shown in more than 30 languages. Pick your language in More tools on the review step. Letters are always written in English so your provider can read them.

faqs.question: How does the letter work?
faqs.answer: We write the letter from the charges you picked. You can edit it, then send it from your own email or copy it. We never send it for you and never see your email.

faqs.question: What is the marked-up PDF?
faqs.answer: It's a copy of your bill with the charges you're asking about highlighted, plus a summary page. You can attach it to your letter. It's made on the spot and never stored.

faqs.question: Is Candorify free?
faqs.answer: Checking your bill is free with an account. Some extra tools are part of a paid plan. See the Pricing page for details.

faqs.question: Do you use AI to find errors?
faqs.answer: No. Errors are found by fixed rules that check the math, totals and repeats on your bill. AI is only used to word translations and to help me answer questions.

faqs.question: Is this medical or legal advice?
ask: can you tell me if i should pay
faqs.answer: No. Candorify helps you spot possible billing issues and ask about them. For medical, legal or insurance decisions, please talk to your provider, insurer or a professional.

faqs.question: What about my insurance?
faqs.answer: We check the bill from your hospital or doctor. It's a good idea to compare it with your insurer's Explanation of Benefits (EOB), and to call your insurer if something doesn't match.

faqs.question: What happens after I send the letter?
faqs.answer: Your provider reviews the charges and replies. If you don't hear back in a few weeks, follow up by phone. Once you know the outcome, tell us on the Results page. It helps the next patient.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: Open your account page (top right) to manage or delete your account. Deleting it removes your saved bills too.

faqs.question: Who made Candorify?
faqs.answer: Candorify was built by a student team at NJIT. You can meet everyone on the Our team page.

faqs.question: How do I contact the team?
faqs.answer: Send us a message below and we'll reply by email.
